cover.sub: 5 niche free tools that will make you
cover.title: disgustingly good at seo in the si era

inner.title: search console first
inner.body: google counts ai overviews and ai mode traffic inside search console's normal web report. the ai clicks you're chasing sit in a free tab you never open.
inner.label: already free

inner.title: bing counts citations
inner.body: bing webmaster tools has a free ai performance report showing copilot citations per page. citations aren't clicks, so a page can feed copilot daily and show zero visits.
inner.label: not a click

inner.title: skip the ai schema
inner.body: google's ai features page says ai overviews need no special schema and no extra technical setup. anyone charging you for ai markup is selling air.
inner.label: selling air

inner.title: read field data
inner.body: pagespeed insights shows real user data against lcp 2.5s, inp 200ms and cls 0.1. what counts is your 75th percentile visitor, not your laptop.
inner.label: 75th percentile

inner.title: ping indexnow
inner.body: one indexnow request tells bing, yandex, naver, seznam and yep about up to 10,000 changed urls. google doesn't take part, so it never replaces search console.
inner.label: not google

seo didn't die.
it got free tools
